author: Little Chinese Everywhere
description:
If you want to experience the China you see in our videos, come travel with us:
littlechineseeverywhere.com/tours

In this video, I travel to Inner Mongolia to experience Naadam, one of the most important traditional festivals of the Mongolian people.
Naadam is a celebration of Mongolian culture and nomadic heritage, bringing communities together through three traditional competitions: Mongolian wrestling, archery, and horse racing.
I’ll take you into the heart of the festival to see how these ancient traditions are still celebrated today, meet local people, and experience a side of Inner Mongolia that you rarely see as a tourist.
